decisions: Add a separate extended append-only slip CSV. Preserve existing pick_log interfaces/headers and frozen T75 modules byte-for-byte.

Auto-import complete unambiguous text; missing/invalid fields return NEEDS_CONFIRMATION without a row. Interactive CLI asks each field; noninteractive usage saves an ignored review JSON for explicit --set/--confirm resume.
Local macOS Vision OCR only. All screenshot fields require confirmation; original screenshot bytes and OCR review are private/ignored and hashed. No external OCR service or credits.
Resolve game only from unique cached schedule match or explicit ID. Never infer timezone, stake currency, unknown line/price, or target game from the current day.

Supported settlement: straight full-game spread/alternate spread, total/alternate total and two-way moneyline, including overtime. Multi-leg/player/period/cashed-out/free-bet slips remain unsupported and are rejected, not partially imported.
Deduplicate identical game/market/side/line/price/stake/currency/book/placement timestamp across pasted/OCR inputs. Actual placement time and later ingestion time remain distinct.
No as-placed model probability is invented. Existing settlement arithmetic is reused. Store profit in original stake currency and per-unit return; do not combine monetary amounts across currencies.

Slip CLV is explicitly nflverse_close_vs_executed_price, based on closing distribution fair probability minus executed-price break-even and executed American price versus closing fair American price. It is separate from T75 forecast-movement CLV and legacy executed-book closes. Post-kickoff wagers have no pregame CLV.
First grade and its result snapshot are immutable, so later final-score corrections cannot silently change W/L/P or CLV. Cached final/close feeds only; no provider requests.

Hourly slip job follows cached daily results. Combined source CSV includes engine, paper_rule and jaret rows with distinct model versions. Legacy joint scorecard adds source and CLV-reference breakdowns; mixed-reference means are suppressed.
Rehearsal caught nondeterministic CSV key order on a second grading run. Canonical export v2 fixes ordering and nested values; failed v1 exports remain preserved. Repeated replay now matches.
limitations: No real slip was supplied; the confirmed example is synthetic and stored outside the production log.
Existing cloud migration remains blocked separately; this job runs on the same Mac.
